case_name: Udyami Evam Khadi Gramodyog Welfare Sanstha and Another v State Of U.P. And Others
petitioner: Udyami Evam Khadi Gramodyog Welfare Sanstha and Another
facts: The appellant is a cooperative society (Samiti) that applied for a loan from the respondents to establish an industry for manufacturing 'Aluminum Pottery'.
A loan of Rs. 5,24,000/- was sanctioned in 1991 and a sum of Rs. 3,09,000/- was released by the respondents.
The Samiti allegedly defaulted in making payments and recovery proceedings were initiated against it.
Several writ petitions were filed by the Samiti questioning the legality thereof.
A public interest litigation was also filed praying for the quashing of recovery certificates issued by U.P. Khadi and Gramodyog Board, Lucknow.
issues: The extent of superior courts' jurisdiction to dismiss a writ petition for alleged suppression of material fact
Whether the appellants have suppressed the material fact of filing four writ petitions on the same cause of action
petitioner_arguments: The statement made by the writ petitioners that no other writ petition was filed on the same cause of action was correct.
The core issue in each of the matters centers round recovery of the amount advanced to the appellants by the bank.
respondent_arguments: In different writ petitions, the petitioners questioned the recovery proceedings, citations and sale of the property.
The appellants have suppressed the material fact of filing four writ petitions on the same cause of action.
court_reasoning: A person approaching a superior court must come with a pair of clean hands.

A writ remedy is an equitable one. A person should not suppress any material fact, but also should not take recourse to the legal proceedings over and over again which amounts to abuse of the process of law.
holding: The appeal is dismissed accordingly with costs.
